item.text:
Yes—if you mean the Vespa CLI, specify the targets independently:

```bash
vespa query 'select * from sources * where true' \
  --target https://query-host.example.com

vespa feed --target https://feed-host.example.com documents.jsonl
```

Vespa documents that `vespa query` accepts a target (`-t/--target`) and that `vespa feed` does likewise. The endpoints must belong to the same Vespa application/deployment (or otherwise route to the same document store); the query host should expose `/search`, and the feed host should expose `/document/v1/`.

Sources: [Vespa CLI documentation](https://docs.vespa.ai/en/clients/vespa-cli.html), [Writing documents](https://docs.vespa.ai/en/basics/writing.html), [Reads and writes](https://docs.vespa.ai/en/writing/reads-and-writes.html).
